title: The Last Tend of Frost

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A stick keeps what a slate would tax. A shelf keeps what a stick cannot say. The month keeps neither, and goes.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the firing women at the yard well in Low Kiln, told in Frost

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and ninety-four to two hundred and ninety-six days, six months and one hundred and fourteen to one hundred and sixteen days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the six hearings of the full note kept beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell kept beside the told; the told figure beside the paid with Frost's first and second arithmetics locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road and the printed one in twelve unchallenged; the dressed grain turned under wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure; the stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate of ice called weather and entered nowhere; the Frost 14 well-saying held with three shapings on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining and not paid; Ilva's ninth record-first hand kept nine with the notched birch strip unread in her sleeve and no figure coming off the stick, no tenth hand filed; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Tarn's loan uncalled, the warm stone cold and unreconciled, Jorra's promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed, Garl held in objects with his name unspoken; the held interval and the empty interval kept as objects on the sixth place; the small coordinations of the hand entered on that place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping, no sixth asking for the row question and no witness, no tenth record-first hand, no eighth of the green or ninth of the shape, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, no private record read, copied or joined, nothing opened, named, called, paid or ended, and Frost 30 (Day 299), the month's third and last Account-day and market, held three mornings ahead and not brought into a day that has not earned it.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fifth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{294}{Frost 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and sixty-second answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap the third shaping — the reader has just read chapter 80. Carry 293 to 294 exact, six months and one hundred and fourteen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-four days with its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places — the carried fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — and agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands. Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell's four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell; Frost's first and second arithmetics locked up the clay road with one in twelve printed and unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; the dressed grain covered and unfigured at the rack end; the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying held with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession and not paid; neither of the district's two habits of naming its months set right or left wrong in so many words (T061/T082, T078, T080, T015/T041/T047/T077 held). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw and *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). Tarn keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, says *Six counted. The next I don't count*, chest tight, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the wrist, the ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth (T036/T076). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and keeps the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-four days and no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-third** answer — the small intake borrowed from the next room held at its top beside the kiln's fourth pull and not carried into the missing fifth, the gap left a gap — exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082). End on the hand laid back against the fold, 294 exact spoken by nobody, and the river's low note going quiet. Target ~2900 words.

scenes.title: The Seven Places Again
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 294, no new dated heading: afternoon of Frost 25 through the going of the light into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and skinned trough, the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals and left on a cold stone; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the trough skinned over and its water called weather; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven are seven and not an account; the missing hand carried, not named, not paid and not joined to the one crust in the fold, the dressed grain under wool or the man carried out on Day 188 (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). She lifts a corner of the wool over the covered grain for damp and lays it back with a progressively lighter touch and no figure, so that the arithmetic still standing four mornings off will read over a thing whose cost it does not know (T077). At the well the white fronds stay on the north lip and the rope gives its dry note; the plate of ice stands clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the boy keeps the white lip, the trough's skin and the plate on places of their own and makes no fourth likeness between them and no cause, for a cause wants a payer standing under it and nobody stands (T083/T085 held). At the kindling Tarn says *Yes, house* to those who want the thaw early and those who want it late, agrees with both so no argument can find a foot, and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying; his stroke goes on over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, and the warm stone in its unmarked loft pot stays cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). Men unnamed go low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and get no name and no word that the room is cold; Jorra's dust comes out of it and his bent finger leads at the damper ahead of an unfinished sentence (T035/T031, T065/T095). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the charcoal, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its handle toward it and a half-beat before she goes away without a look toward the bed; the widow's mark is untouched because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-fourth** answer — two intakes from the next room held apart with a finger between, the nearer one ending early, the early ending kept whole as an absence and not made into a bridge or a filled place — exact and worth nothing, none of it promoted (T061/T082). End on the file open on the towel with the held interval and the empty interval parted by a finger and nothing moved, the frost white on the well lip beyond the finger's-width door. Target ~2700 words.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Sixth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{295}{Frost 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; Frost 26 comes on its own morning and nothing of the day before is brought into it as a lesson, sign or payment. Carry 294 to 295 exact, six months and one hundred and fifteen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-five days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before — hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool, the sour breath of the corner called the thaw, the river low over lower under the finger's-width door, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell. Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed empty place and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the surgeon's knowing that a face may seem eased before it is worse and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly buys him nothing at two inches of air, and the older keeps the inventory while the younger keeps the wanting, neither with authority over the other (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh kept empty; the heard bell beside the told in its square; the told figure beside the paid with one in twelve unchallenged and the space between figure and price unsigned; the three shapings of the well-saying held with a finger between every pair and not standing up as a witness; the dressed grain covered and unfigured; the stayed frost and the plate of ice called weather (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047/T077, T080, T083/T085 held). Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the fire, wool, pot, broom and running water and never to the basket, *the house* and *The house will keep it*, half-pace from every open slate, finger above the charcoal, grain turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched (T058/T079, T100). Tarn keeps the knife at the edge of its sill and the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the creases, the clip-ring holding what light there is, the loft stone cold (T036/T076, T006). Jorra's dust, the damper ahead of the sentence, the four burned-slate tellings, two shut-room tellings, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart and the row at five askings with no witness all stand as they stood; Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-five days and no collector on the clay road (T035/T031/T062, T064, T065/T095, T101, T009/T013/T092). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-fifth** answer — the river's low note taken on one side of the finger and a letting-go from the next room on the other, two sounds in two places, neither crossing to the other and neither supplied with a fifth — exact, complete and worth nothing, not a hearing or a joining (T061/T082). End on the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with its handle turned toward it, and no look toward the bed. Target ~2800 words.

scenes.title: The Count in Wood
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Frost 26 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the yard well, the boards and the well-roof, the drying racks and rack end, the bed and the towel. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T080):** Ilva of the firing work, a woman of the yard and not of the house, is glimpsed once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she does not scrub out; her hands are not soft, and the district would not turn its head twice for her. A neighbour with a pot asks what the firings of the month have taken now the month is nearly out; a slate lies open on the stone lip where somebody has set it, with the writing turned toward its owner and nobody reading it aloud. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there; the short strip of notched birch bark is not taken out, read, counted, asked about, copied or joined to the slate, and no figure comes off the stick. She answers the question put and not the one behind it: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* The boy reads the order of reaching — hand to the record, eyes to the asker, mouth after both — and files it as the **ninth** record-first hand on its own place beside the eighth, with a finger between every pair; he files **no tenth hand**, takes no figure off the wood, and sets the nearness of the open slate on a place of its own as an absence rather than a joining. Nine hands are nine and must not stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands to any of them; the strip waits for the far-off day a hand not his lays the district's private keepings together. This does not make Ilva a reader, a party to any account or a witness; it is not joined to Hessa Rale's edge-on slate, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, Berr's twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate, Alda's six pages, Mira's cords, Orra's knots, the reed-cutter's cord or Dessa's pewter tin, and the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying stay on their own place beside Hessa's eighth hand with a finger between, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession and not paid, and not joined to Ilva's strip. Sella hears the exchange and goes on with the house, bringing nothing under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment. The boy keeps the stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate as weather entered nowhere (T083/T085 held) and goes wide with her around the seven places with no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-sixth** answer — the order of a reaching taken as an object and laid on the ninth hand's own place, the open slate's nearness kept as an absence with a finger between, neither promoted into a reading, a joining, a tenth hand, a hearing, a payment or a rule (T061/T082, T080 advanced). End on the strip staying in the sleeve under the flat of her hand while she goes back to the pail, and the boy's hand coming down on the river's note with the ninth hand left nine. Target ~3600 words.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{296}{Frost 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing seen at the well yesterday is brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, witness or payment. Carry 295 to 296 exact, six months and one hundred and sixteen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-six days with its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before; the body inventoried in the old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; he knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, and the older keeps the inventory while the younger keeps the wanting, neither with authority over the other (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh kept empty; the heard bell beside the told; the told figure beside the paid and Frost's two arithmetics behind and unread with the printed one in twelve unchallenged; the three shapings held apart and not a witness; the nine hands held at nine with Ilva's strip unread and offstage today, no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth; the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047/T077, T080 held, T101, T036/T076, T064, T065/T095). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, keeps her finger above the charcoal, moves her lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch, sets the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). Tarn keeps six and the seventh at the lip, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent and the stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra keeps his forearms dusty, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, moves the damper ahead of the unfinished sentence and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Garl's name is unspoken two hundred and ninety-six days and no collector comes up or down the clay road (T035/T031/T062, T009/T013/T092). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-seventh** answer — the empty interval taken from the file and set beside the held interval with a finger between, the finger put down and taken up and both intervals left where they were, a keeping and not a spending — exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082). End on the hand laid back against the fold with 296 exact and spoken by nobody and the file open with every gap left gap. Target ~2700 words.

scenes.title: Three Mornings Off
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 296, Frost 27, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed, the boards and the towel. Frost goes out in its last tend without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left wrong; no lesson is made of Frost's first arithmetic or Frost's second, both locked up the clay road in Berr's box with one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, and no payer is named to either; three mornings ahead stands Frost 30 (Day 299), the month's third and last Account-day and market, and it is not brought into a day that has not earned it or made a sign (T015/T041/T047/T077). Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). Sella goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the stayed frost on the well lip, the skinned trough and the plate of ice clouded with silt on its flat stone stay weather entered nowhere, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named to any (T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The dressed grain is turned once more beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure (T077). Tarn keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles and the pale clip-ring, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes up or down the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra's dusty forearms are parted from clean, the damper's double bite is an object joined to no kiln, the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings together with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T064, T065/T095, T101). Garl stays in objects and not in a story — the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the wheel-seat keeping its lean and hollow, the clean dark line with its finer grey beside it unswept, the proverb said to the pot and the fire, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled — his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-six days (T009/T013/T092). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the charcoal, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and does not touch the widow's mark, because a going of the light is not an opening and the next opening stands in the first firing of a later month, far off, not hoped for and not counted toward; four openings in four months are four and not a rule (T058/T079, T100). In the small hours the file is turned out on the towel as instruments on a tray: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go and never with the things that came from vessels; the heard bell beside the told; the told figure beside the paid; the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying on a place of their own beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession and not paid, and not joined to Ilva's strip in a sleeve a pace off yesterday, to Berr's thumb, to the clerk's inward slate or to the charcoal; nine hands held at nine with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the house's not-doings on a place of its own apart from his own gaps with a finger between (T061/T082, T080 held, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T060/T086). The hand files its **one hundred and sixty-eighth** answer — the small intake taken at the very end of the day and let go on the same note, whole and unjoined, the hand coming down on the river's low note of water over water without supplying the kiln's fifth or crossing the room's letting-go — exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, none of it a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082). The surgeon's clean satisfaction at the exact coordination is checked by the infant's plain want of the crust two inches off, and the checking is the work and he does not call it a virtue. Close: one hundred and sixty-eight honest answers stand on the sixth place and 296 stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and sixteen days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed; nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended and no thread was opened or closed. End on the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door after the hand comes down, the crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and nothing that had moved, and the plate of ice standing clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet. Target ~3200 words.
